text:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝟭𝟯𝟮/𝟭 𝗜𝗡 𝟮𝟱! 🇮🇳

India U19 are 132/1 chasing 338 in the Asia Cup final v Pakistan.
Sehwag out for 58 after a 95 opening stand; Raichandani 50*.
206 more needed from 25 overs.

Can they do it? 👇

#U19AsiaCup #INDvPAK

𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝟭𝟯𝟮/𝟭, 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗦𝗘 𝗝𝗔𝗥𝗜! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 U19 Asia Cup final mein India ko 338 chahiye, 25 over baad score 132/1
👉 Sehwag ne 58 banaye, opening stand 95 ka tha
👉 Captain Raichandani 50* pe khel rahe hain
👉 Jeetne ke liye 25 overs mein 206 run aur chahiye

India chase kar paayegi? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #U19AsiaCup #INDvPAK
